title: Round-trip drift outcomes
description: The answers an adjudicator may give on ONE passage round-trip QA flagged. All three are reasons recorded against the L1 completeness verdict, which Lane_0 owns; what differs is the obligation each creates.

source.note: bean bvuk; the owner's own answer set and design, 2026-09-23

codes.label: The drift is real
codes.definition: The translation lost or changed the source's meaning, or used the wrong term; recorded as the reason against the completeness verdict.

codes.label: False positive
codes.definition: The two readings say the same thing. Recorded so the passage stops being re-flagged on every run.

codes.label: The SOURCE is wrong
codes.definition: The flag is right but the fault is in the source, not the translation. The one answer that sends work out of this process: re-translating a wrong source cannot produce a right target.
